ui_widget.title: HUB75 64x64 RGB LED Matrix Panel
ui_widget.board_svg_content:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 450 350" width="450" height="350">
  <!-- Main Dark PCB Board Base -->
  <rect width="450" height="350" rx="12" fill="#070b12" stroke="#1e293b" stroke-width="3"/>
  
  <!-- PCB Corner Mounting Holes -->
  <circle cx="15" cy="15" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#64748b" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <circle cx="435" cy="15" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#64748b" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <circle cx="15" cy="335" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#64748b" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <circle cx="435" cy="335" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#64748b" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- Power Terminal (5V / GND) -->
  <rect x="16" y="25" width="55" height="32" fill="#0f172a" stroke="#475569" stroke-width="1.5" rx="3"/>
  <text x="43" y="18" fill="#ef4444" font-size="8" font-family="monospace" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">+5V GND</text>
  <circle cx="30" cy="41" r="5" fill="#f59e0b" stroke="#78350f" stroke-width="1"/>
  <circle cx="55" cy="41" r="5" fill="#64748b" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- HUB75 Connector Pin Header (16-pin) -->
  <rect x="16" y="125" width="30" height="95" fill="#0f172a" stroke="#475569" stroke-width="1.5" rx="3"/>
  <text x="31" y="114" fill="#94a3b8" font-size="8" font-family="sans-serif" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">HUB75E</text>
  <!-- Pins 1..16 -->
  <circle cx="23" cy="136" r="2" fill="#f59e0b"/><circle cx="39" cy="136" r="2" fill="#f59e0b"/>
  <circle cx="23" cy="148" r="2" fill="#f59e0b"/><circle cx="39" cy="148" r="2" fill="#f59e0b"/>
  <circle cx="23" cy="160" r="2" fill="#f59e0b"/><circle cx="39" cy="160" r="2" fill="#f59e0b"/>
  <circle cx="23" cy="172" r="2" fill="#f59e0b"/><circle cx="39" cy="172" r="2" fill="#f59e0b"/>
  <circle cx="23" cy="184" r="2" fill="#f59e0b"/><circle cx="39" cy="184" r="2" fill="#f59e0b"/>
  <circle cx="23" cy="196" r="2" fill="#f59e0b"/><circle cx="39" cy="196" r="2" fill="#f59e0b"/>
  <circle cx="23" cy="208" r="2" fill="#f59e0b"/><circle cx="39" cy="208" r="2" fill="#f59e0b"/>

  <!-- IC Shift Register Chips (SMD) -->
  <rect x="60" y="75" width="18" height="38" fill="#1e293b" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="1" rx="1.5"/>
  <text x="69" y="96" fill="#64748b" font-size="5" font-family="monospace" text-anchor="middle">74HC595</text>

  <rect x="60" y="240" width="18" height="38" fill="#1e293b" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="1" rx="1.5"/>
  <text x="69" y="261" fill="#64748b" font-size="5" font-family="monospace" text-anchor="middle">FM6124</text>

  <!-- 1:1 Square Display Screen Outer Frame (300x300 centered with generous margins) -->
  <rect x="110" y="25" width="300" height="300" fill="#020408" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="2" rx="4"/>
</svg>
